title: Generative Search and Recommendation at Shopify
abstract: arXiv:2611.08804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search and recommendation at Shopify require retrieving relevant products from a changing catalog of billions of products under strict latency constraints. We present SID-LLM, which casts both tasks as generating semantic IDs: short sequences of content-derived tokens representing products. We jointly pre-train SID-LLM on catalog and behavioral data, giving search and recommendation a shared representation and training objective. We show that reinforcement learning further improves judged search relevance. Furthermore, distillation from task-specific experts improves recommendation quality over joint supervised fine-tuning without a statistically detected loss in search quality. Finally, for efficient serving, we pair multi-token prediction with a lightweight ranker, improving retrieval quality over our autoregressive baseline while reducing latency. translated_title: Shopify 的生成式搜索与推荐
translated_abstract: Shopify 的搜索和推荐系统需要在严格的延迟约束下，从不断变化的数十亿商品目录中检索相关商品。我们提出了 SID-LLM，将这两项任务都建模为生成语义 ID：即由内容派生的 token 组成的、用于表示商品的短序列。我们在商品目录数据和行为数据上对 SID-LLM 进行联合预训练，为搜索和推荐提供了共享的表示和训练目标。我们证明强化学习可以进一步提升经人工评判的搜索相关性。此外，通过从任务特定的专家模型进行蒸馏，相比联合监督微调能够提升推荐质量，同时在统计上未检测到搜索质量的损失。最后，为了高效服务，我们将多 token 预测与轻量级排序器相结合，在降低延迟的同时提升了相对于自回归基线的检索质量。我们既将 SID-LLM 作为独立检索器进行评估，也将其作为 Shopify 生产系统的组件进行评估。
tldr: Shopify 提出 SID-LLM，将搜索与推荐统一建模为生成语义 ID 的任务，通过目录与行为数据联合预训练、强化学习、专家蒸馏以及多 token 预测结合轻量级排序器，实现了高质量、低延迟的检索与推荐。
en_tdlr: Shopify presents SID-LLM, which unifies search and recommendation as semantic ID generation, leveraging joint pretraining on catalog and behavioral data, reinforcement learning, expert distillation, and multi-token prediction paired with a lightweight ranker to achieve high-quality, low-latency retrieval and recommendation.
